title_zh: 郎朗：用钢琴打动世界的音乐家
title_en: Famous Chinese People (10/20): Lang Lang, the Pianist Who Moved the World
note_en: 被誉为 (bèi yùwéi) means "is hailed as, is acclaimed as": 被誉为当代最杰出的钢琴家之一 "is hailed as one of the finest pianists of our time." It is a more formal, admiring version of 被称为 "is called," used only for praise. Note the pattern 最…之一 "one of the most…": where English puts "one of" first, Chinese puts 之一 at the very end.
